label: Thresholds for realism/ (check_swing_realism, check_shot_realism). Every entry: value, source, tag. Tags: published (value printed in a source), derived (computed from published numbers), assumption (my choice, no source), extrapolated (outside every published population), model (golfphys output, not a measurement). No Mason / Instagram data.

measured_chs_range_mph.source: Cheetham 2008 amateur 88 / pro 109 mph (Parker 103, Myers n/a)
measured_chs_range_mph.note: inside this range segment peaks are interpolated between measured groups; outside it they are extrapolated

lead_before_club_peak_ms_amateur.source: Cheetham 2008 (amateurs; thorax/arm order swapped on average)

lead_band_ms_warn.source: derived: roughly +/-50 % around the Cheetham means
lead_band_ms_warn.note: warn outside; sim control rate 50 Hz gives only 20 ms resolution

tie_tolerance_ms.source: env control dt = 0.02 s (docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL / env substeps)
tie_tolerance_ms.note: peaks closer than this are treated as simultaneous (warn, not fail)

swap_warn_ms.source: Cheetham amateurs: arm/thorax order swapped by 5 ms on average

rows_by_chs.source: kseq-reference scaling_to_chs (Cheetham two-group power-law fit, data/speed_gap_100_120.py)
rows_by_chs.note: rows tagged extrapolated at 90, 120, 132 mph; 100 and 110 are between measured groups

pass_ratio.source: published spread: pelvis 358-519 deg/s across studies (Cheetham/Parker/Myers), Parker SD 10-16 %; definitions (resultant vs yaw) differ

top_of_backswing_deg.source: Parker 54.9+-7.9 (elite), Myers 44.2/49.5/59.1, Hume review 24-38 (long vs short hitters), Burden 70; kseq doc recommends 45-62

stretch_deg.source: Parker 2.9+-3.4; joint-coordinate studies 1-3 deg; Cheetham sensor method ~10+ deg
stretch_deg.note: small stretch must not be penalised (kseq recommendation 3)

g1_tiers_tau_Nm_w_rad_s.source: env/g1_golf_env.py tier table, read by kseq-reference
g1_tiers_tau_Nm_w_rad_s.note: stock = Unitree G1 rated; elite = HYPOTHETICAL

torque_overshoot_fail_ratio.source: env derates torque linearly to 0 at rated speed; exceeding the peak is a simulation/clipping bug

feasibility_ratio_avg_by_tier_chs.source: kseq-reference feasibility_g1_env (required avg power from Nesbit work scaled to CHS / 0.23 s over max available tau*w/4); groups hips, spine, spine_all_axes, shoulders, elbows, wrists, wrists_pitch_only
feasibility_ratio_avg_by_tier_chs.note: 120/132 rows extrapolated; > 1 means infeasible on average, peak need ~2.5x average

human_wrist_torque_cap_Nm.source: Sprigings & Neal 2000 simulation limit (search summary only, unverified)
human_wrist_torque_cap_Nm.note: S-tag in kseq doc; warn only

pelvis_yaw_avg_torque_Nm_downswing.source: derived in kseq doc section 5: 150-300 N*m average at 100-116 mph (Barrentine/Hume shear couple + Nesbit hip work 423 J)

grip_torque_Nm_by_chs.source: Nesbit 2005 linear fit through 4 swings, extrapolated >116 mph

grip_torque_pass_ratio.source: n=84 Nesbit 22-40 N*m about the fit; wide for definition differences

lead_vertical_bw.source: Worsfold 2007 front 0.84; Han 2019 1.12+-0.22 (S); Hirano 2023 1.51; Hume review 1.6-2.0 (per foot or summed unclear); studies differ ~2x
lead_vertical_bw.note: no GRF target is defensible; this only catches non-physical traces (pulling down on the ground, > 3 BW)

smash_driver.source: launch_targets_120_132_limits.json gate_recommendation (TrackMan smash blog, R&A WLD, PGA Tour pdf)
smash_driver.note: 1.50 is a COR/mass ceiling; Burke 141 mph ~1.50 single shot

value.note: warn bands 1200-1800 and 3000-4000 per gate_recommendation (1500-1800/3000-3500 explicitly; the gap is warn)

spin_rpm_driver.note: driver at 120-132 mph; tour average 2545-2686, WLD 2789

launch_deg_driver.source: TrackMan optimizer 7.8-9.3 at AoA 0 (120-132 mph), Foresight window 10-14, WLD 11.2, tour 10.4-11.2

descent_deg_driver.source: tour 36-39 (snippet, roll_aoa_validation descent anchors); golfphys gives 33-50 over normal launch/spin

total_over_carry.source: roll_aoa_validation (normal turf 1.07-1.13, firm ~1.2); TrackMan total optimizer 1.17-1.22
total_over_carry.note: total < carry is impossible; 1% slack for averaged gate rows (env has no roll: ratio ~1.00 warns)

golfphys_carry_residual_yd.source: golfphys vs TrackMan chart within ~3 yd (consistency only); vs Foresight 14-33 yd lower at 120-145 mph (unresolved vendor disagreement)
golfphys_carry_residual_yd.note: residual = reported carry - golfphys carry from reported ball speed/launch/spin

spin_axis_abs_deg.source: stock scatter spec; MyGolfSpy centre-bin axis tilt -3..-6 deg
spin_axis_abs_deg.note: only when the shot dict carries spin_axis_deg

club_speed_range_mph.source: R&A WLD 145 mph, record ball speed 241.6 mph (Berkshire) -> club speed ~165 mph; sim below 60 mph is not a driver swing
